claims.text: In Les Misérables, Jean Valjean is first sent to prison for stealing a loaf of bread.
Valjean's first prison sentence was not for stealing a candlestick, a horse or a pocket watch.
Valjean stole the bread to feed his sister's starving children.
With added time for escape attempts, Valjean served 19 years in prison.
Later, a bishop shields Valjean after he steals the bishop's silver, and this act of mercy transforms him.
